name: cxr_classifier_tool
description: Zero-shot CXR (chest X-ray) pathology classification using MedCLIP. Classifies images across 14 CheXpert findings using vision-language contrastive embeddings. Supports DICOM and standard image inputs.

help.summary: Run zero-shot CXR pathology classification using MedCLIP.
help.notes: Uses BiomedCLIP (open_clip) when available, falls back to CLIP (transformers). Classifies 14 CheXpert labels: No Finding, Cardiomegaly, Edema, Pneumonia, Atelectasis, Pneumothorax, Pleural Effusion, and more.
